query:
INSERT INTO issue_descriptions
                   (id, issue_id, version, kind, title, description, original_text,
                    enhanced_text, intake_id)
               VALUES ($1, $2,
                       (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version), 0) + 1 FROM issue_descriptions
                        WHERE issue_id = $2),
                       $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8)
               RETURNING version as "version!: i64"
